purpose: small fixed authoritative cross-molecule structural-transfer batch; not a representative molecular benchmark
response_policy: store every returned response byte unmodified; record HTTP/download failure and do not substitute another CID
preparation: concatenate successful complete response files in declared CID order using their original bytes; no SDF reserialization, filtering or artificial hydrogen addition
future_comparison: original batch bytes and complete hydrogen_slots_v1 frame receive the same separately declared PAQv216 -4 AVX2 command
